properties.description: Two corrections to what the design tells a reader about itself, both found by the design misleading its own agent. Closure had two available answers and the two surfaces each read a different one, so a finding another record had refuted came back from search with no marker at all; it is now one graph-aware computation both surfaces use. And the unreachable-vocabulary count was a flat 43 that conflated a hole somebody wants filled with a property an operation writes, where a caller parameter would let somebody forge a computed fact; split by intent it is 14 holes, 15 written by an operation, 13 unused.
properties.name: v0.53.0 cut — a refuted finding stops reading as current, and a count starts meaning something
